key_concepts: Protein synthesis involves transcription and translation
Transcription produces mRNA from a DNA template
mRNA carries genetic information from the nucleus to ribosomes
Translation assembles amino acids into proteins using mRNA codons
Codons are groups of three mRNA bases that specify amino acids
tRNA anticodons pair with mRNA codons during translation
The genetic code table is used to translate mRNA sequences into amino acids
Mutations are changes in the DNA base sequence
Some mutations may not change the amino acid sequence due to codon redundancy
Mutations can alter protein structure and function
SARS-CoV-2 is a positive-strand single-stranded RNA virus
Mutations in the SARS-CoV-2 spike protein can increase virus transmissibility
